answer: Admission is priced per relationship, not per key. A new identity exists only if a staked identity endorses it, and that endorser posts collateral slashed when the invitee proves fake. Honest operators vouch only for checked work, so a farm must get staked nodes to risk value on every edge, and it grows only where members underwrite. One fraud proof travels the component, voiding collateral on every route in, so all keys fail together. A pulse of cheap signups buys no breadth: average cost per key never reaches a nadir, and the delta between honest and farm economics widens per edge.
